**Current**
- Experts expect him to miss time, with a projection of about 60 to 65 games. 60 games would count as a win. (verdict, 2026-10-15; [08-20](https://youtu.be/s28HvC2grAk?t=1800), [10-15](https://youtu.be/bd8GYKFOe8A?t=623), [08-26](https://youtu.be/sTtFUy7IoJI?t=1035), [10-10](https://youtu.be/hviT4hzYNME?t=680))
- In head-to-head, experts would not draft him inside the top 40. Round 4 or later is fine, around pick 41 to 45. (verdict, 2026-10-15; [10-15](https://youtu.be/bd8GYKFOe8A?t=623), [10-13](https://youtu.be/EogBYa24Gto?t=559), [10-12](https://youtu.be/w66x_I_MaQ8?t=620), [10-11](https://youtu.be/uI6umXsE7Vk?t=611), [10-08](https://youtu.be/6DnRWahYrFA?t=497), [09-24](https://youtu.be/_vbAP5y182A?t=643), [09-30](https://youtu.be/BjXP9JODDSg?t=633), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=2398), [09-14](https://youtu.be/LM0cRCGoAUQ?t=1200), [09-10](https://youtu.be/dlo7L8Ru91A?t=933), [09-15](https://youtu.be/KPdD91Oo8-U?t=687), [08-24](https://youtu.be/g31YlwRe0XQ?t=536))
- In an auction, the most an expert would pay is 24 USD. He sold for 20 USD in that mock. (verdict, 2026-10-05; [10-05](https://youtu.be/Q6YlQDvD-aY?t=298))
- Experts rate him a top 10 per-game player, with a tight per-game range. Games played is the open question. (verdict, 2026-09-17; [07-13](https://youtu.be/Rqb5GdrSweY?t=417), [08-19](https://youtu.be/J1Eg3uaAICU?t=684), [09-17](https://youtu.be/DubdKKhMWHo?t=751), [09-16](https://youtu.be/2A2JbUN-kc0?t=2442))
- He takes Brandon Ingram's spot and is a projected starter next to Quickley, Barrett, Barnes and Poeltl. (fact, 2026-09-10; [06-30](https://youtu.be/JMSLg6yz-M0?t=347), [08-20](https://youtu.be/s28HvC2grAk?t=496), [09-10](https://youtu.be/dlo7L8Ru91A?t=473))
- He should play some or most back-to-backs, but not necessarily all of them. Load management in Toronto is likely. (verdict, 2026-09-10; [06-30](https://youtu.be/JMSLg6yz-M0?t=407), [08-16](https://youtu.be/gf_6GveiAls?t=839), [08-16](https://youtu.be/gf_6GveiAls?t=1044), [09-10](https://youtu.be/W-R1dzem32s?t=1224))
- Toronto acquired him in a trade. He faces no punishment from the league ruling on the investigation. (fact, 2026-09-03; [06-30](https://youtu.be/JMSLg6yz-M0?t=347), [08-20](https://youtu.be/s28HvC2grAk?t=77), [07-13](https://youtu.be/Rqb5GdrSweY?t=363), [09-03](https://youtu.be/OBwWCxG9SqM?t=142))
- Much of Toronto's offense should run through him, with usage moving to him and away from Barrett and Quickley. (verdict, 2026-08-20; [08-20](https://youtu.be/s28HvC2grAk?t=532), [06-30](https://youtu.be/JMSLg6yz-M0?t=566))
- Toronto has 15 back-to-backs, three of them in the fantasy playoffs. (fact, 2026-08-16; [08-16](https://youtu.be/gf_6GveiAls?t=1037), [08-16](https://youtu.be/gf_6GveiAls?t=1044))

**Durable**
- Steals are his standout category, far above the pool. He also helps in points, FT% and FG%, and he has no weak category. (fact, 2026-10-16; stats)
- Experts do not trust his knees to hold up. Injuries and load management worry them more than his talent does. (verdict, 2026-10-15; [10-15](https://youtu.be/bd8GYKFOe8A?t=623), [10-14](https://youtu.be/D4dP5JvX1oo?t=634), [10-13](https://youtu.be/KqTKVExQGLo?t=916), [10-06](https://youtu.be/eTsjuVu1trk?t=1617), [07-13](https://youtu.be/Rqb5GdrSweY?t=405), [08-20](https://youtu.be/s28HvC2grAk?t=2004), [08-09](https://youtu.be/8d--aL_xxwE?t=914))
- He has a degenerative knee condition with repeated surgeries in the same knee (meniscus, ACL, quad tendinopathy). He also carries ankle sprain risk. (fact, 2026-09-17; [09-17](https://youtu.be/DubdKKhMWHo?t=734), [06-30](https://youtu.be/JMSLg6yz-M0?t=395), [08-09](https://youtu.be/8d--aL_xxwE?t=914))
- He is a high-usage scorer and a good, willing three-point shooter who makes decisions quickly. (fact, 2026-08-20; [06-30](https://youtu.be/JMSLg6yz-M0?t=240), [08-20](https://youtu.be/s28HvC2grAk?t=1236))
- He is one of the best free throw shooters in recent memory. (verdict, 2026-06-30; [06-30](https://youtu.be/JMSLg6yz-M0?t=268))

**Tags**
- Current: `back-to-back risk` (Should play some or most back-to-backs, not necessarily all. Toronto has 3 back-to-backs in the playoffs.), `new team` (Traded to Toronto), `sites disagree on price` (Yahoo value 26 USD and rank 36. ESPN value 40 USD and rank 20.), `bust candidate` (At ESPN value 40 USD or rank 20. Experts would not take him inside the top 40 in H2H.), `winning team` (52 wins predicted. Possibly a top-four team in the East.)
- Durable: `STL specialist` (About 1.7 steals per game projected), `fits every build` (No weak category in the profile), `elite per game` (Top 10 per game. Games played is the question.), `injury prone` (Degenerative knee with repeated meniscus, ACL and quad tendinopathy surgeries. Also ankle sprain risk.), `load management` (Likely load management in Toronto)

**Note.** Per game he is a top 10 player who fits every build, with standout steals and help in points, FT% and FG%. Experts agree his knee makes him a round 4 or after-pick-40 call in H2H, and the most they would pay is 24 USD. That fits his Yahoo price (26 USD value, 24.9 USD average cost) and the 20 USD he cost in our league last season, but not the ESPN value of 40 USD. Early in the season, check how many of Toronto's back-to-backs he plays and whether the knee holds up. He is a strong buy only near 20 to 24 USD.
